fusions.name: The Long Wait Ends
fusions.desc: Clamps onto an enemy, which deals 32 damage and is always a critical hit. It leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolled Prey
fusions.desc: Rolls through a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 8 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sunk Snare
fusions.desc: Sinks a snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 60 seconds, and deals 24 damage in a blast around it to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Longer the Stillness
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 12 seconds.
